answer: Pearl-diving human-puzzle chain: a new identity must collect a pearl at a staffed wharf checkpoint by solving a fresh chain of human-only puzzles — visual reasoning, audio riddles, and dexterity trials that wander across formats no script can cover at once. Each pearl is a single-use, short-lived token tied to that session, so one person can only dive once per window. A farmer running a thousand puppets must pay a thousand humans to sit through a thousand puzzle chains, turning bulk forgery from cheap automation into an expensive payroll.
